scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent:$npm_execpath" in pnpm/*|*:*/pnpm*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: corepack pnpm run typecheck && corepack pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.ci: corepack pnpm run typecheck && corepack pnpm run build:api && corepack pnpm run build:web
scripts.typecheck:api: corepack pnpm --filter @workspace/db run typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @workspace/api-zod run typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @workspace/integrations-openai-ai-server run typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run typecheck
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm run typecheck:libs && corepack pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
